summary: CS.MONEY Takas Botu — CS:GO/CS2 Skin ve Eşyaları Için Hızlı Takas, Alım ve Satım Botu — use as UI reference for cs.money. Typical flow: navigation → hero → search-bar → stat-cards → feature-grid. Rebuild with your own brand, copy, and assets; do not clone the source site.

components.name: Navigation
components.purpose: Site-wide header navigation and primary CTAs.
components.designNotes: Keep sticky/top bar compact; avoid dense menus in the first pass.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Primary above-the-fold value proposition and main CTA.
components.designNotes: Wide, tall hero band — prefer full-bleed composition over inset cards.

components.name: SearchBar
components.purpose: Primary find/filter entry for catalog or inventory.
components.designNotes: Center or align with hero; keep a single clear field.

components.name: StatCards
components.purpose: Trust or metric strip with short numeric highlights. (×2 landmarks collapsed).
components.designNotes: Equal card rhythm; numbers lead, labels stay secondary. Appears ×2 in the extract.

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.purpose: Feature or benefit grid explaining product modes.
components.designNotes: One idea per cell; avoid card chrome unless interaction needs it.

components.name: Section01
components.purpose: Landmark without a confident pattern — treat as a custom section. (×2 landmarks collapsed).
components.designNotes: Do not invent a fake pattern; design from layout intent. Appears ×2 in the extract.

components.name: CtaBanner
components.designNotes: High contrast against page background; one action only.

components.name: FaqAccordion
components.purpose: Expandable Q&A for objections and trust.
components.designNotes: Start with one open item; keep answers short.

components.name: About
components.designNotes: Keep copy brief; link out for deep detail if needed.

components.name: InfoBlock
components.purpose: Topical information section (mode, security, community, etc.). (×4 landmarks collapsed).
components.designNotes: Repeatable content section with clear id-level topic. Appears ×4 in the extract.

designSystem.radius: Radius roles: corners 4px; pills 50px; avatars circle; full=9999px.

usageHint: Give this brief to an AI as the only site-reference context: rebuild the layoutFlow with your brand using designSystem tokens; treat components as empty intent shells, not content to copy.
